name: SEE Science Center Summer Camps
description_short: One week science day camps at the SEE Science Center in Manchester that mix hands on experiments with creative projects. Several camps split campers into two age groups.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page; 2026 details: one week day camps 9:00 to 3:30, $325 a week ($310 for members), aftercare 3:30 to 5:00 for $50 a week, campers bring lunch; 14 sessions over seven weeks in 2026; 2027 registration opens in February

warnings: Only general 2026 details are posted: price, hours, aftercare and lunch. The 2026 camp titles, dates and age groups are no longer on the page.
Members pay $310 a week; families enrolled in EBT, SNAP or SunBucks pay $50 a week; extra weeks can be $275 with a code. $50 of each registration is non-refundable.
2027 details will be posted in February 2027.
unknowns: financial aid beyond the EBT discount

for_andrew: The SEE camps page has 2026 prices and hours but no 2026 session dates or ages, and 2027 information comes in February. Publish a thin listing now, or wait until February?
